focus: جلسه نهم · آینده غیرقطعی / going to

sentences.fa: در خدمتتونم، چه فرمايشي داريد؟
sentences.en: I am at your service, what can I do for you?

sentences.fa: براي شام بر مي گردي؟ مهمون دارم.
sentences.en: Are you coming back for dinner? I have got some guest.

sentences.fa: مادرت کي بر مي گرده؟
sentences.en: When is your mother coming back?

sentences.fa: اشکال نداره يه مقدار پول ازت قرض کنم؟ پولت رو سريع بر مي گردونم.
sentences.en: Is it ok if I borrow some money? I am paying your money back very soon.

sentences.fa: برادرت شماره ات رو داره؟
sentences.en: Has your brother got your number?

sentences.fa: من بهش زنگ مي زنم.
sentences.en: I am calling him.

sentences.fa: بخشکي شانس، چه حيف!
sentences.en: Just my luck, what a shame!

sentences.fa: تا خرخره گيرم، چي کار کنم؟
sentences.en: I am up to my eyes, what shall I do?

sentences.fa: برادرت امشب مهموني مي آد؟
sentences.en: Is your brother coming to the party tonight?

sentences.fa: ماشين ندارم، چطوري ماشين بگيرم؟
sentences.en: I haven't got a car, how shall I take a taxi?

sentences.fa: خونه مي رسونمت.
sentences.en: I am taking you home.

sentences.fa: من رو هتل مي رسوني؟
sentences.en: Are you taking me to the hotel?

sentences.fa: مي شه من رو هتل برسونيد؟
sentences.en: Could you take me to the hotel?

sentences.fa: چرا اينجا نشستي، داری هي بهم نگاه مي کني؟
sentences.en: Why are you sitting here, looking at me over and over?

sentences.fa: کجا بشينم؟ پدرت دم خونه ايستاده ، منتظر کسي هست.
sentences.en: Where shall I sit? your father is standing at the door, waiting for someone.

sentences.fa: اون مرده کيه كه داره از خونه ام بيرون مي آد؟
sentences.en: Who is that man coming out of my house?

sentences.fa: چرا کراوات زدي؟
sentences.en: Why are you wearing a tie?

sentences.fa: مهموني مختلط مي آيي؟
sentences.en: Are you coming to a coed party?

sentences.fa: چيزي براي شام نداريم، چي بخوريم؟
sentences.en: We haven't got any thing for dinner, what shall we eat?

sentences.fa: سر راهم چندتا ساندويچ مي خرم.
sentences.en: I am buying some sandwiches on the way.

sentences.fa: شام بيرون مي خوري؟
sentences.en: Are you eating dinner out?

sentences.fa: مي شه براي شام يه چيزي درست کني؟ من مي آم خونه.
sentences.en: Could you cook something for dinner? I am coming home.

sentences.fa: روزه اي؟
sentences.en: Are you on a fast?

sentences.fa: برادرت رژيمه؟
sentences.en: Is your brother on a diet?

sentences.fa: پکر بنظر مي رسي، چي شده؟
sentences.en: You look solemn, what is it?

sentences.fa: بعداً بهت مي گم.
sentences.en: I am telling you later.

sentences.fa: باهات صحبت مي کنم.
sentences.en: I am speaking with you.

sentences.fa: امسال برام چي مي خري؟
sentences.en: What are you buying for me this year?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده، روزنامه مي خونه، می خنده، سيگار مي کشه، سوت مي زنه، خميازه مي کشه پدرته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, reading the newspaper, laughing, smoking cigarette, whistling, yawning your father?

sentences.fa: مردي که دم در ايستاده و سوت مي زنه کيه؟
sentences.en: Who is that man standing at the door, whistling?

sentences.fa: بخشکي شانس، سرم خيلي شلوغه، مي شه جلسه رو به تعويق بندازي؟
sentences.en: Just my luck! I am fully tide up, could you postpone the meeting?

sentences.fa: بهت زنگ مي زنم و باهات صحبت مي کنم.
sentences.en: I am calling you and speaking with you.

sentences.fa: در رو قفل می کنی؟ من کليد ندارم.
sentences.en: Are you locking the door? I haven't got a key.

sentences.fa: اشکالي نداره در رو قفل کنم؟
sentences.en: Is it ok if I lock the door?

sentences.fa: بيکاري يه چيزي براي شام بپزي؟
sentences.en: Are you free to cook something for dinner?

sentences.fa: يه چيزي برات سفارش مي دم.
sentences.en: I am ordering something for you.

sentences.fa: چي سفارش بديم؟
sentences.en: What shall we order?

sentences.fa: چيزي هم داري بگي؟
sentences.en: Have you got anything to say?

sentences.fa: من بعداً همه چي رو توی جلسه بهت مي گم.
sentences.en: I am telling you everything at the meeting later.

sentences.fa: براي شام چي می خوري؟
sentences.en: What are you eating for dinner?

sentences.fa: مي خوام استيک سفارش بدم، براي تو چي؟
sentences.en: I would like to order a steak, what about you?

sentences.fa: من استيک مي خورم.
sentences.en: I am eating the steak.

sentences.fa: تو چي مي خوري؟
sentences.en: What are you eating?

sentences.fa: چي بخورم؟
sentences.en: What shall I eat?

sentences.fa: کجا پارک کنم، جاي پارکي اينجا نيست.
sentences.en: Where shall I park? there aren't any car parks here.

sentences.fa: من ماشين رو پارک مي کنم، نگران نباش.
sentences.en: I am parking the car, don't worry.

sentences.fa: يسري سؤال دارم، بپرسم؟
sentences.en: I have got some questions, shall I ask you?

sentences.fa: کي جوابم رو مي دي؟
sentences.en: When are you answering me?

sentences.fa: سرم شلوغه، بعد از جلسه جوابت رو مي دم.
sentences.en: I am fully tide up; I am answering you after the meeting.

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم؟ شروع کنيم. سؤالي داري؟ سؤالي ندارم، شروع کنيم.
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start. Have you got any questions? I haven't got any questions, let's start.
